issue.title: Fix dashboard filter
issue.body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Open a dashboard with a native filter on the `country` column.
2. Select a value in the filter.

Expected behavior: every chart on the dashboard is filtered to the selected country.
Actual behavior: the table chart ignores the filter and keeps showing all countries.
Affected code: `superset-frontend/src/dashboard/components/nativeFilters/` and the filter scope resolution.
Acceptance criteria: the table chart honours the native filter and the dashboard filter tests pass.
